variants.policy: Named checkpoint variants are mandatory; remaining cross-cutting variants are planned overlays, not multiplied into base counts. Freeze overlay entries before implementing a runner.

gaps.description: Starter voice intro is coming soon; capture disabled affordance, not a recording journey.
Web push is unavailable; capture honest unavailable state only.
Component tests and emulator evidence do not establish fresh OS/provider delivery or negative delivery guarantees.
No tablet rail or desktop sidebar; do not classify existing bottom tabs as atlas failures.
Failed swipes restore the card but do not surface an explicit error; atlas captures this existing state rather than inventing feedback.

coverage.note: Definition counts only. No capture or coverage verification has run.

scopeExclusions: Static marketing website apps/website is outside this Expo-client manifest.
Backend-only cleanup and security invariants need tests/provider receipts, not invented screens.
Future location/ranking, voice recording and unimplemented navigation shells are not working journeys.

fixtureContract.accounts: Disposable emulator accounts A and B with explicit complete/incomplete profiles; do not use owner data.
fixtureContract.time: Freeze age calculations, timestamps, resend countdown and sign-in freshness per checkpoint.
fixtureContract.pending: Hold named owning-layer promise/subscription until after capture; settle via state assertions.
fixtureContract.errors: Reject named operation with the localized error code called out by setup; no production outage required.
fixtureContract.twoAccountChat: Use two independent authenticated contexts; create mutual likes and messages through UI. Fixture ordering may be controlled; never inject replies and call it a two-account proof.
fixtureContract.negativeCases: No-write/no-alert/account-fence results require behavioral assertions in addition to screenshots.
fixtureContract.privacy: Use synthetic portraits and text; redact device account identifiers and credentials; never put token values in sidecars.
